interpretation: Desktop Node warm-call measurements with eight balanced pairs and eight identical-build controls per suite. Rendering, complete frame pacing, physical devices and allocation-volume measurement are outside this timing scope.

initialShortSamples.reason: Short settlement and starter-selection samples showed large variation in identical-build controls. Those workloads were lengthened before the final run.

settlementComparison.scope: Warm desktop Node settlement calls through real game entry points. Eight balanced four-process rotations include the previous SDK twice as a control. Captured state and zero awards must agree. Physical devices and complete frame timing are outside this workload.

conclusions.rewardSelection: Pending and active selection improved in both recorded runs. The final paired ratios are about 0.81 and 0.46 relative to the original game.
conclusions.classSettlement: Inconclusive across repeated courses and identical-build controls. The new guard ordering retains the safety check. No general settlement-speed claim is accepted.

exploratoryPredecessorComparison.scope: Earlier run of the same 65000-call helper and balanced four-process order, before promoting the public runner. Retained alongside the public-runner replication.
